source: lane lock-wrapper-io: lock_discipline_check now follows funcall of *fnn-write-syscall*
title: The log frame write (fnn-log-pwrite -> fnn-write-range -> unix-write) runs under the log lock K from fnn-snapshot-job-freeze-log (snapshot-producer.lisp:542 -> fnn-log-rotate io.lisp:8648)
notes: Sibling of the already-baselined R2|fnn-log-pwrite|K:sb-posix:lseek (same call, the write half the checker could not see). Trail: fnn-snapshot-job-freeze-log (snapshot-producer.lisp:542) -> fnn-log-rotate (io.lisp:8648) -> fnn-log-pwrite (io.lisp:7350) -> fnn-write-range (io.lisp:683). K serializes the log, so a stalled write blocks every appender and the syncer for its duration. Decision owed: rotation's seal frame written under K by design (declare K io_ok-for-rotation with the bound, a contract row) or the freeze moves the write out of K. Not the checker's to decide.
